messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft & next steps

Hi Janelle / Tom / Procurement team —

Great to meet with you this morning. Thanks for walking through the integration priorities and the pilot success criteria. Per our call, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-Acme-Healthcare-v1.2.xlsx) that captures the milestones, owners, and an initial target close. Short summary below:  

- Target close (proposal signature): 2026-04-15 (initial ask)
- Milestones:
  1) Budget approval (Acme) — owner: Janelle Park
  2) Legal review & redlines — owner: Tom Alvarez / procurement
  3) Integration POC (2-week) — owner: Acme engineering, support: Redwood Solutions
  4) Pilot & success metrics sign-off — owner: Product / Clinical Ops
- Dependencies: budget sign-off, network readiness, legal SOW sign-off
- Attachments: MAP-Acme-Healthcare-v1.2.xlsx, SLA-Appendix.pdf

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm owners above and whether the 2026-04-15 target is realistic for your internal approval cycles?
2) If budget/approval needs a longer runway, please indicate a revised target close so we can re-sequence milestones and update resource planning.
3) If helpful, we can provision a short pilot environment for the POC (we estimate ~3 business days to stand up once LOE is agreed).

I'll follow up internally with our CS/solutions team to surface any constraints. Thanks — cc'ing Rishi + Dylan for visibility.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@acmehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from our side after an internal check: the finance committee schedule shifted and we will not have final budget approval until mid-May. Realistically we need to reforecast the target close to 2026-05-20.

Requests / notes:
- Please move "Budget approval" to the first milestone and add an explicit "Finance committee sign-off" item.
- Legal has a tighter review window in early May; Tom will own pushing redlines and expects to loop counsel by 5/6.
- Procurement attached a short note with the expected PO timeline (see Procurement-Notes-AH.pdf).

If you can send an updated MAP that shows the 5/20 close and reprioritized milestones, we can confirm owners and get the DocuSign workflow queued. Also flag any risks if the POC start date shifts later — we may need to push the pilot window.

Appreciate it —
Janelle
Sr. Dir, Digital Transformation
Acme Healthcare
janelle.park@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Procurement-Notes-AH.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme MAP timing — internal notes

Marissa / Dylan —

Saw Janelle's reply. Budget slip to mid-May is manageable but has two implications for us:

1) Resource blocking: the POC environment slot we penciled in for late-April may need to shift into late-May. We should confirm whether Solutions can absorb that change or if we need to de-prioritize another pilot.
2) Commercial: if the customer wants to hold signature until budget approval, suggest we offer either a) a 60-day credit hold for committed capacity or b) maintain pricing but push start-of-usage date — both protect revenue but keep customer engaged.

Can you please:
- Update the MAP to reflect 2026-05-20 close and reprioritized milestone order (budget -> legal -> POC -> pilot).
- Add a column for "Commercial option" where we surface the two options above and recommended default.
- Highlight any risks to delivery SLAs if pilot shifts into June.

I'll be available to join next call with Acme if they want to walk through options.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Janelle / Tom / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the procurement note. Per our internal alignment, attached is an updated MAP and an executive summary below. I also added a short commercial options table as requested.

Executive summary / changes:
- Reforecasted target close: 2026-05-20 (moved from 4/15)
- Reprioritized milestones: 1) Finance committee sign-off / Budget approval (owner: Janelle) -> 2) Legal review & redlines (owner: Tom) -> 3) Integration POC (owner: Acme eng, Redwood support) -> 4) Pilot & sign-off
- New milestones added: "Finance committee packet submitted" (target: 2026-04-28) and "Legal counsel review" (target: 2026-05-06) to reflect your windows
- Commercial options:
  A) 60-day credit hold on committed capacity (no immediate charge until contract effective) — recommended if finance needs runway
  B) Execute now, defer usage start date to contract effective (preserves pricing certainty)
- Dependencies called out: procurement PO window, network/connectivity readiness, and resourcing for the POC environment

Attachments included: MAP-Acme-Healthcare-v1.3.xlsx (updated MAP with owners, dates, and risks), SLA-Appendix.pdf, Procurement-Notes-AH.pdf

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-12345 | DocuSign (pre-fill): https://docusign.example/sign/0a1b2c3d4e

If you'd prefer, happy to jump on a 20-minute touchpoint early next week to run through the MAP.

Best,
